# ExternalHookRunner Port

## Rules

- `ExternalHookRunner` declares machine-readable accepted explicit external hook types; declaration solely controls dispatch. Never infer from registration name or implementation class.
- Executes explicit entries using `external.type`, `external.config`, and current workflow template variables. Remains separate from shell-only `HookRunner`.
- No registered runner declaring requested type: fail clearly; never ignore or treat as no-op.
- Results match workflow hook semantics for pre-phase failures, post-phase reporting, and CLI/user-facing behavior.

## Constraints

- Application-layer port.
- Accepted external hook types declared explicitly.
- Unknown external hook types are hard errors.
- Never conflate with `HookRunner`.
